newsitem.title: USA: Ekco sells Ekco Consumer Plastics unit.
newsitem.headline: Ekco sells Ekco Consumer Plastics unit.

text.p: Ekco Group Inc said its Ekco Consumer Plastics unit has entered into a letter of intent to sell substantially all of its assets to Alpha Holdings Inc of Dallas for undisclosed terms.
As part of the deal it is expected that Alpha will license the Ekco name for use in the sale of plastic products and will lease the company's Worcester, Mass., facility.

The company reported the results of the plastics division and its loss on disposal as a discontinued operation for the fourth quarter and 1996 year. Ekco reported losses for both its 1996 fourth quarter and year earlier today.
